keyFindings.summary: Build local executable evidence and ownership fixtures before behavioral refactors.
Cache-optimizer cross-process persistence is the highest-severity correctness package.
DeepPi's structured persistent report is the next product-facing foundation.
Fix cost semantics now but defer causal claims until controlled ablation.
Ship cheap provenance gates before staged modularization and defer unproven lock complexity.
